# s355 — affected.py tests pin the clean probe at discover start

**Findings:** s344 gate 2026-10-17: no test fails if the clean probe moves after the run (implementer mutation M10 survived); the dirty-then-committed test writes its unclean map by hand · **Size:** S · **Tree:** tests

**Not in this slice:** an end-of-run probe (owner decision), or changing map borrowing.

## Why

s344 records `"clean"` from a probe taken when the full discover starts. Moving the probe to the end of the run passes every test, so a regression that records a tree cleaned mid-run as clean would go unnoticed.

## Files

- `tests/test_affected.py`: a test where the tree is dirty at start and clean by the end records `clean: false`; record the unclean sibling map through a real dirty run where practical.

## Failing tests
